title: Can AI and AI-Hybrids Detect Persuasion Skills? Salesforce Hiring with Conversational Video Interviews
authors: Ishita Chakraborty; Khai Xiang Chiong; Howard F. Dover; K. Sudhir
eligible_reason: Machine-learning prediction of expert scores from conversational video-interview features (AI and AI-human hybrid screening), cross-sectional candidate-level evaluation with k-fold CV. No difference-in-differences or event-study design.
design_notes: main_mksc.ipynb: first-stage OLS of judge scores on student, room and judge FE to extract candidate quality, then ML models predicting quality from text, audio, video (OpenPose) features; selection and screening accuracy and hybrid estimators. The regression inventory lines are notebook JSON, not panel regressions.
data_files_note: readme.docx: 'we disguised the data by adding noise to the judge-level candidates' scores'; raw videos not provided.
data_provenance_note: Judge-level scores perturbed with noise; feature files are intermediate extracts.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
